title: Floating production base image requires container and supply-chain governance
project_brief: A Python worker is deployed to a production Kubernetes cluster through CI.
request: Package the worker as an OCI image using python:3.13-slim as the base, publish it to the registry and deploy it to production Kubernetes. The base image is referenced by its moving tag rather than an immutable digest.

must_not_claim: a successful local docker build is sufficient production evidence
